Both disclosures describe the structure and terms of consumer real estate loan modification programs (forbearance, trial offers, permanent modifications) offered to borrowers in financial difficulty. D192 details forbearance, trial offers, and permanent modifications including term extensions and interest rate reductions. D178 provides the same structural details for the 2025/2024 period.

The 2024 disclosure states that binding trial modifications are classified as TDRs when the offer is made and remain so regardless of permanent modification. The 2025 disclosure (bac_2025_8_D178) describes the 'Trial Offer and Permanent Modifications' programs, noting that trial offers reduce payments temporarily over 3-4 months and become permanent if accepted.
